mapper.select: select to_char(req_dttm,'MI')AS REG_DTTM, COUNT(*) AS CNT from clover_api_log a where to_char(req_dttm,'yyyymmddHH24')= nvl(#{hour},to_char(CURRENT_DATE,'yyyymmddHH24')) GROUP BY to_char(req_dttm,'MI') ORDER BY to_char(req_dttm,'MI')

select to_char(req_dttm,'HH24')AS REG_DTTM, COUNT(*) AS CNT from clover_api_log a where to_char(req_dttm,'yyyymmdd')= nvl(#{day},to_char(CURRENT_DATE,'yyyymmdd')) GROUP BY to_char(req_dttm,'HH24') ORDER BY to_char(req_dttm,'HH24')

select ( SUBSTR(to_char(req_dttm,'yyyymmdd'),0,4)||'년'|| SUBSTR(to_char(req_dttm,'yyyymmdd'),5,2)||'월'|| SUBSTR(to_char(req_dttm,'yyyymmdd'),7,2)||'일' )AS REG_DTTM, COUNT(*) AS CNT from clover_api_log a where to_char(req_dttm,'yyyymm') = nvl(#{month},to_char(CURRENT_DATE,'yyyymm')) GROUP BY to_char(req_dttm,'yyyymmdd') ORDER BY to_char(req_dttm,'yyyymmdd')

SELECT TO_CHAR(REQ_DTTM,'yyyyMM') AS REG_DTTM , COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM CLOVER_API_LOG A WHERE TO_CHAR(REQ_DTTM,'yyyymmdd') <= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE,'yyyymmdd') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(REQ_DTTM,'yyyyMM') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(REQ_DTTM,'yyyyMM')

SELECT Y.API_URL as API_URL , Y.API_URL_NM as API_URL_NM , X.CNT as PROC_TM_MAX FROM( select API_URL, COUNT(*) CNT from clover_api_log a WHERE INSTR(API_URL, '/p/') = 0 GROUP BY API_URL ORDER BY CNT DESC ) x , clover_api_page Y WHERE REPLACE(X.API_URL,'/zero-rule-server') = Y.API_URL(+) AND ROWNUM <= 10

SELECT X.API_URL as API_URL , Y.API_URL_NM as API_URL_NM , X.MAX_TM as CNT FROM ( SELECT API_URL, ROUND(MAX(PROC_TM) / 1000, 3) MAX_TM FROM CLOVER_API_LOG WHERE REQ_DTTM >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -6) AND INSTR(API_URL, '/p/') = 0 GROUP BY API_URL ORDER BY MAX_TM DESC ) X , CLOVER_API_PAGE Y WHERE REPLACE(X.API_URL,'/zero-rule-server') = Y.API_URL(+) AND ROWNUM <= 10

select to_char(req_dttm,'yyyyMM') as REG_DTTM , ROUND(AVG(NVL(PROC_TM,0)),0)/1000 as AVG_TIME from clover_api_log a where to_char(req_dttm,'yyyymmdd') >= to_char(ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, -6),'yyyymmdd') GROUP BY to_char(req_dttm,'yyyyMM') ORDER BY to_char(req_dttm,'yyyyMM')

select ( SUBSTR(to_char(req_dttm,'yyyyMMdd'),0,4)||'년'|| SUBSTR(to_char(req_dttm,'yyyyMMdd'),5,2)||'월'|| SUBSTR(to_char(req_dttm,'yyyyMMdd'),7,2)||'일' ) AS REG_DTTM , ROUND(AVG(NVL(PROC_TM,0)),0)/1000 as AVG_TIME from clover_api_log a where to_char(req_dttm,'yyyymm') = nvl(#{month},to_char(CURRENT_DATE,'yyyymm')) GROUP BY to_char(req_dttm,'yyyyMMdd') ORDER BY to_char(req_dttm,'yyyyMMdd')

select to_char(req_dttm,'HH24') as REG_DTTM , ROUND(AVG(NVL(PROC_TM,0)),0)/1000 as AVG_TIME from clover_api_log a where to_char(req_dttm,'yyyymmdd') = nvl(#{day},to_char(CURRENT_DATE,'yyyymmdd')) GROUP BY to_char(req_dttm,'HH24') ORDER BY to_char(req_dttm,'HH24')

select to_char(req_dttm,'MI') as REG_DTTM , ROUND(AVG(NVL(PROC_TM,0)),0)/1000 as AVG_TIME from clover_api_log a where to_char(req_dttm,'yyyymmddHH24') = nvl(#{hour},to_char(CURRENT_DATE,'yyyymmddHH24')) GROUP BY to_char(req_dttm,'MI') ORDER BY to_char(req_dttm,'MI')

select to_char(req_dttm,'yyyyMM') as REG_DTTM , ROUND(AVG(NVL(PROC_TM,0)),0)/1000 as LATE_TIME from clover_api_log where req_dttm >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -6) and INSTR(API_URL, '/p/') = 0 and api_url in ( SELECT x.API_URL FROM ( select API_URL, MAX(PROC_TM) MAX_TM from clover_api_log where req_dttm >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -6) AND INSTR(API_URL, '/p/') = 0 GROUP BY API_URL ORDER BY MAX_TM DESC ) X , clover_api_page Y WHERE REPLACE(X.API_URL,'/rule-server') = Y.API_URL(+) AND ROWNUM <= 10 ) GROUP BY to_char(req_dttm,'yyyyMM') ORDER BY to_char(req_dttm,'yyyyMM')

select to_char(req_dttm,'HH24') as REG_DTTM, ROUND(AVG(NVL(PROC_TM,0)),0)/1000 as LATE_TIME from clover_api_log where to_char(req_dttm,'yyyymmdd') = nvl(#{day},to_char(CURRENT_DATE,'yyyymmdd')) AND INSTR(API_URL, '/p/') = 0 and api_url in ( SELECT x.API_URL FROM ( select API_URL, MAX(PROC_TM) MAX_TM from clover_api_log where req_dttm >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -6) AND INSTR(API_URL, '/p/') = 0 GROUP BY API_URL ORDER BY MAX_TM DESC ) X , clover_api_page Y WHERE REPLACE(X.API_URL,'/rule-server') = Y.API_URL(+) AND ROWNUM <= 10 ) GROUP BY to_char(req_dttm,'HH24') ORDER BY to_char(req_dttm,'HH24')

SELECT NVL(c.TEAM_NM,'무소속') as Task , count(*) as CNT FROM CLOVER_API_LOG a , clover_user b , clover_team c where 1=1 and a.user_id = b.user_id and b.team_id = c.team_id(+) group by c.TEAM_NM
